text:
marco: Heads-up: found a reproducible issue in the Go quickstart sample around generator streaming + auth refresh. When the sample uses context.Background() the iterator lifecycle is ambiguous and with short token TTLs we can hit a race that leads to panics or double-close errors.

yun: Can you paste the minimal repro + stack?

marco: Minimal snippet (exactly what we ship in quickstart):

```go
ctx := context.Background()
c := client.New(ctx, client.Opts{Model: \"mini\"})
it := c.Generator().Stream(\"prompt\")
for it.Next() {
  fmt.Println(it.Value().Text)
}
if err := it.Err(); err != nil { log.Println(\"iter err:\", err) }
```

stack: \"panic: send on closed channel\" originating from gen/streamer.push in some runs. Repro: run with TOKEN_TTL=2s and have another goroutine call c.Close() after ~1s while iterating. Intermittent: panic, io.ErrClosedPipe, or silent double-close.

tara: Two separate issues here: 1) the sample encourages Background which makes ownership fuzzy; 2) token refresh path mutates shared transport/token source while active stream goroutines are writing to channels 99-> race.

yun: Short-term mitigations: update the quickstart sample to use request-scoped context (New(req.Context(), ...)) and show iterator ownership via explicit it.Close() in the handler. Add a small TTL-toggle repro script so engineers can reproduce locally.

yun: SDK-side mitigations: serialize token refresh (singleflight or mutex) so we don't swap transports mid-stream, and have the iterator hold a stable transport reference until Close() is called.

marco: From an ergonomics angle: I propose adding an explicit Iterator type that implements Close() error and documenting that client.Close() is for process shutdown only. We can keep old behaviors behind a compatibility shim for one release.

tara: Good plan. Also add an integration test that forces concurrent refresh + caller cancel with -race, assert no panics and deterministic Err() values. CI should run that test nightly for a bit.

sdk-parity-bot: Note: if you change public API surface, file a parity ticket and follow PARITY-58 checklist.

marco: Filed INF-5120: \"go quickstart: streaming iterator races with auth refresh\". Attached repro, TTL toggle script, and minimal test.

qa-bot: INF-5120 created and linked to nightly -race job. Please add a deterministic TTL script to make flake reproducible.

yun: Also adding a short snippet to Quickstart \"Streaming pitfalls\": avoid context.Background() for request-bound generators, prefer request ctx + iterator.Close(), and example singleflight token refresh boilerplate.

tara: If we do the iterator type change, let's prototype it behind a feature flag and ship sample+docs first so users get the correct pattern immediately. We'll sync with parity for the API change.

marco: I'll open a small PR to update the sample and docs (no API changes). Follow-up PR will add SDK guards + iterator prototype behind a flag and the new integration test. Will @sdk-parity when ready. Thanks folks.
